tasks.title: Ancient Egyptian Medicine
paras: Ancient Egyptian medicine was advanced for its time and laid the foundation for many modern practices. Egyptians believed the body was a system of channels similar to the Nile River. Illness was thought to be caused by blockages in these channels, like a blocked canal causing flooding. Treatments focused on unblocking channels using herbal remedies and physical interventions. One significant contribution of Egyptian medicine was surgical techniques. Ancient texts describe procedures like the removal of tumors and the setting of broken bones. They also record practices like cleaning wounds and disinfecting medical instruments. This suggests that Egyptian doctors understood the connection between cleanliness and preventing infections, a concept widely accepted only much later in history. In addition to surgery, Egyptians were skilled in pharmacology. They used substances like honey and willow bark to treat ailments. Modern science has validated some ancient remedies; for example, willow bark contains salicin, a precursor to aspirin, with pain-relieving properties. While Egyptians demonstrated an impressive body of knowledge, Egyptian medicine was also intertwined with religion. Many treatments involved prayers and rituals to invoke the favor of the gods. This blend of empirical practice and spiritual belief shows the complexity of ancient Egyptian medicine.

questions.stem: The author mentions “a blocked canal causing flooding” to explain

options.A: the importance of the Nile River for Egyptian culture
options.B: the ancient Egyptians’ idea of why humans became sick
options.C: the wide variety of illnesses common in ancient Egypt
options.D: the connection between agriculture and medicine

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 修辞目的题 原文定位： “Egyptians believed the body was a system of channels similar to the Nile River. Illness was thought to be caused by blockages in these channels, like a blocked canal causing flooding.” 正确答案分析： 作者提到“堵塞的运河导致洪水”是为了类比说明古埃及人对疾病原因的理解：他们认为身体内的通道堵塞会导致疾病，就像运河堵塞会导致洪水一样。因此选项 B 正确。 选项分析： (A) the importance of the Nile River for Egyptian culture 尼罗河对埃及文化的重要性 —— 错误，这不是作者举例的目的。 (B) the ancient Egyptians’ idea of why humans became sick 古埃及人对人生病原因的看法 —— 正确。 (C) the wide variety of illnesses common in ancient Egypt 古埃及常见疾病的多样性 —— 错误，文中未讨论疾病种类。 (D) the connection between agriculture and medicine 农业与医学之间的联系 —— 错误，文中未涉及农业。

questions.stem: The passage suggests that which of the following was a surprising achievement of ancient Egyptian medicine?

options.A: Its procedures improved greatly over time.
options.B: It understood the importance of cleanliness in preventing infections.
options.C: Its use of Nile River water was often successful.
options.D: Its understanding of the cause of illnesses was largely accurate.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 推断题 原文定位： “They also record practices like cleaning wounds and disinfecting medical instruments. This suggests that Egyptian doctors understood the connection between cleanliness and preventing infections, a concept widely accepted only much later in history.” 正确答案分析： 文中指出，古埃及医生理解清洁与预防感染之间的联系，而这一概念在历史上是很久以后才被广泛接受的。因此这可以被视为一个令人惊讶的成就。选项 B 正确。 选项分析： (A) Its procedures improved greatly over time. 其程序随着时间的推移有了很大改进 —— 错误，文中未讨论时间上的改进。 (B) It understood the importance of cleanliness in preventing infections. 它理解了清洁在预防感染方面的重要性 —— 正确。 (C) Its use of Nile River water was often successful. 它对尼罗河水的使用常常成功 —— 错误，文中未提及。 (D) Its understanding of the cause of illnesses was largely accurate. 它对疾病原因的理解基本准确 —— 错误，他们的理解是基于“通道堵塞”的观念，并非现代意义上的准确。

questions.stem: Why does the author discuss the use of willow bark?

options.A: To suggest that some ancient remedies could be harmful
options.B: To explain the invention of aspirin
options.C: To highlight the variety of natural remedies available in Egypt
options.D: To show that some ancient Egyptian remedies were effective

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型： 修辞目的题 原文定位： “They used substances like honey and willow bark to treat ailments. Modern science has validated some ancient remedies; for example, willow bark contains salicin, a precursor to aspirin, with pain-relieving properties.” 正确答案分析： 作者提到柳树皮，是为了说明现代科学已经验证了一些古老的疗法是有效的，因为柳树皮中含有水杨苷，具有止痛特性。因此选项 D 正确。 选项分析： (A) To suggest that some ancient remedies could be harmful 暗示一些古老的疗法可能有害 —— 错误，文中未提及有害。 (B) To explain the invention of aspirin 解释阿司匹林的发明 —— 错误，文中只是提到柳树皮是阿司匹林的前体，并未解释阿司匹林的发明过程。 (C) To highlight the variety of natural remedies available in Egypt 强调埃及可用自然疗法的多样性 —— 错误，重点是验证有效性，而非多样性。 (D) To show that some ancient Egyptian remedies were effective 表明一些古埃及疗法是有效的 —— 正确。

questions.stem: The word “invoke” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型： 词汇题 原文定位： “Many treatments involved prayers and rituals to invoke the favor of the gods.” 正确答案分析： “invoke” 意为“祈求、恳求”，在句中指通过祈祷和仪式祈求神灵的恩惠。因此 “request”（请求、恳求）是最接近的含义。 选项分析： (A) request 请求、恳求 —— 正确。 (B) understand 理解 —— 错误。 (C) increase 增加 —— 错误。 (D) express 表达 —— 语义不准确。

questions.stem: What role did religion play in ancient Egyptian medicine?

options.A: Doctors were trained by religious authorities.
options.B: Religious beliefs limited the kinds of medicine that could be used.
options.C: Prayers and rituals were often a part of medical treatment.
options.D: Doctors were thought to have special connections to the gods.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型： 细节题 原文定位： “While Egyptians demonstrated an impressive body of knowledge, Egyptian medicine was also intertwined with religion. Many treatments involved prayers and rituals to invoke the favor of the gods.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确指出，埃及医学与宗教交织在一起，许多治疗涉及祈祷和仪式。因此选项 C“祈祷和仪式常常是医疗的一部分”正确。 选项分析： (A) Doctors were trained by religious authorities. 医生由宗教权威培训 —— 错误，文中未提及。 (B) Religious beliefs limited the kinds of medicine that could be used. 宗教信仰限制了可以使用的药物种类 —— 错误，文中未提及限制。 (C) Prayers and rituals were often a part of medical treatment. 祈祷和仪式常常是医疗的一部分 —— 正确。 (D) Doctors were thought to have special connections to the gods. 医生被认为与神灵有特殊联系 —— 错误，文中未提及医生的特殊地位。
